title: Power and institutions
learning_outcomes: Explain formal and informal power in the context of power and institutions.
Compare and distinguish stakeholders in the context of power and institutions.
Apply accountability in the context of power and institutions.
Evaluate and justify decisions about ethical safeguards in the context of power and institutions.

lessons.title: Formal and informal power
lessons.outcome: Explain formal and informal power in the context of power and institutions.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving formal and informal power; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to stakeholder map.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain formal and informal power from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of formal and informal power; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Stakeholders
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish stakeholders in the context of power and institutions.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving stakeholders; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to stakeholder map.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain stakeholders from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of stakeholders; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Accountability
lessons.outcome: Apply accountability in the context of power and institutions.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving accountability; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to stakeholder map.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain accountability from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of accountability; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Ethical safeguards
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about ethical safeguards in the context of power and institutions.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving ethical safeguards; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to stakeholder map.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain ethical safeguards from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of ethical safeguards; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of formal and informal power; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of stakeholders; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of accountability; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of ethical safeguards; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.
assessment.reviewer: Experienced leader, governance or organisational psychology reviewer.

safety.notes: Respect consent, privacy and applicable rules; source and subject review before publication.
